text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Osaka Hai, and the
crowd is
excited to see Уиннинг Тикит
and Нарита Таисин
race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит becomes anxious about
living up
to her fans' expectations and
racing against
Нарита Таисин.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Even so, she gets herself pumped to race
against
her rival and run a great race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
